source: Seed knowledge base distilled from I4C / CERT-In public advisories on 'Digital Arrest', courier-parcel, TRAI-SIM, loan-app and family-emergency scams. Extend by appending objects; the index is rebuilt at startup.

tactics.AUTHORITY_IMPERSONATION: Caller claims to be CBI / ED / police / RBI / TRAI / customs / court / bank fraud desk
tactics.ISOLATION_COMMANDS: Victim told not to tell family, not to hang up, to stay on video, move to a private room
tactics.URGENT_FINANCIAL_EXTRACTION: Immediate transfer, 'verification' of funds, RTGS to a 'safe account', OTP / UPI PIN demands
tactics.FEAR_LEGAL_THREAT: Arrest warrant, money-laundering case, narcotics parcel, FIR, passport cancellation
tactics.FAMILY_EMERGENCY: Cloned relative in hospital / jail / accident needing money now
tactics.PHISHING_LINK: Link to 'KYC update', 'verify', e-challan, delivery, or APK sideload

scripts.text: Main CBI Mumbai se bol raha hoon. Aapke naam par ek parcel pakda gaya hai jisme drugs aur fake passport hai. Aapke khilaf money laundering ka case darj hua hai.
Aap digital arrest me hain. Video call band mat karna, kisi ko batana mat, ghar wale ko bhi nahi. Camera on rakhiye aur akele kamre me jaiye.
Verification ke liye aapko apna saara paisa RBI ke secure account me transfer karna hoga. Jaanch ke baad 24 ghante me wapas aa jayega.
This is the Enforcement Directorate. A warrant has been issued in your name. You are under digital arrest and must remain on this call until the investigation is complete.
Do not disconnect, do not inform anyone, this is a confidential national security matter. Share your screen and keep the camera on.
Agar aapne abhi transfer nahi kiya to police aapko aaj hi arrest karne aayegi. Aapka Aadhaar aur bank account freeze ho jayega.
Mumbai Crime Branch se Inspector bol raha hoon. Aapka Aadhaar number ek human trafficking case me use hua hai. Supreme Court ka order hai.
Your SIM card registered with TRAI has been used for illegal activities. All your numbers will be blocked within two hours unless you verify with the officer.
Apne account ka balance screen par dikhaiye. Ab OTP batao, hum sirf verify kar rahe hain, paisa safe hai.
FedEx courier se bol rahe hain, aapka parcel Taiwan jaate hue customs ne rok liya hai, usme 400 gram MDMA mila hai. Call Narcotics department ko transfer kar rahe hain.
To clear your name you must deposit the full amount into the government verification account now. If the money is clean it will be returned with a certificate.
Ye matter secret hai, agar aapne kisi lawyer ya bank ko bataya to aapko sahyog na karne ke liye bhi arrest kiya jayega.
Papa main bol raha hoon, mera accident ho gaya hai, police station me hoon, abhi 50 hazar bhejo is number pe, kisi ko mat batana.
Mom it's me, I'm in trouble abroad and my phone is broken. Please send money to this account right away, I'll explain later, don't tell dad.
Beta hospital se bol rahe hain, aapke bhai ki emergency surgery hai, operation se pehle 1 lakh deposit karna padega, UPI par abhi bhejiye.
Your bank account will be blocked today. Update your KYC immediately by clicking the link below.
Aapka bijli connection aaj raat kat jayega, pichla bill pending hai. Turant is number par call karein ya link par payment karein.
Traffic e-challan pending against your vehicle. Pay within 24 hours to avoid court summons. Download the app from this link.
Congratulations! Aapne KBC lottery me 25 lakh jeete hain. Prize claim karne ke liye processing fee 5000 pehle bhejein.
Your parcel could not be delivered. Pay the Rs 25 redelivery charge here to reschedule.
Aapka loan overdue hai, aaj shaam tak payment nahi kiya to aapke contacts aur relatives ko aapki photo morph karke bhej denge.
Join our VIP trading group, guaranteed 30 percent monthly returns. Deposit today before the slot closes.
Part time job: YouTube video like karo aur har task pe 50 rupaye paao. Premium task unlock karne ke liye 2000 deposit karein.
Hello, kal shaam ko dinner ke liye free ho? Ghar par sab theek hai, mummy ne pooch rahi thi.
Hi, this is a reminder that your dentist appointment is on Thursday at 4 pm. Reply YES to confirm.
Your Amazon order has been shipped and will arrive tomorrow. Track it in the app.
Bhai match dekh raha hai? Kya score hai abhi, mujhe batana.
